speaker: Doctor
text: That is very helpful; your history of partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly strongly suggests Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH). While CAH can cause ambiguous genitalia and virilization, it does not typically present with the severe bone fragility and delayed menarche you described unless there is a concurrent chromosomal anomaly like Turner Syndrome (45,X/46,XX mosaicism) causing mixed gonadal dysgenesis. Given your request for a single conclusion, do you have any known family history of ovarian failure or short stature? DIAGNOSIS READY: Turner Syndrome with Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia
